name: standoff-spigot
title: SMD spacer, internal thread, spigot
summary: As standoff, with the narrower spigot below the seating plane that locates it in the board's hole (spigot_diameter, spigot_length).
provenance: Original work, authored through SolidCraft's commands by `cargo test -p sparksmith-solidcraft --test author_parts -- --ignored` (`author_parts/families.rs`); dimensions from Würth Elektronik's public WA-SMSI drawing (M3, 9774015360R family drawing, revision 001.002, 2020-05-11; https://docs.rs-online.com/6ef4/0900766b8166610d.pdf downloaded 18 November 2026): Ø6.0 mm, spigot Ø4.2 × 1.4 mm, M3, saved at L = 10 mm (9774100360R); chamfers estimated. No CAD or EDA library data was copied; product photographs were only looked at for comparison.
